entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used when the UE wishes to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the network.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that initiates transmission of protocol data to the network using the PCO IE.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options not supported
entities.description: Condition where extended protocol configuration options are not supported by the UE or the network end-to-end for the PDN connection.

relations.description: UE action to transmit protocol data triggers inclusion of PCO IE in message
PCO IE inclusion is guarded by the condition that extended PCO is not supported
